blurb: Classes included ballet, jazz, tap, hip hop, lyrical, and acro dance, providing children with a solid foundation in dance and the opportunity to express themselves. Dance Kids Canada focused on exploring the joy of dance and personal development through dance. They produced professional quality DVD packages of recitals and held live shows in significant theatres with professional costumes and Hollywood quality show DVDs and Blu-ray HD.
